findings.message: power net +3V3 (6 pads) has no copper pour/plane — power should be poured, not carried by thin tracks: `pcb pour-fit --net +3V3` (2-layer) or `pcb power-planes` (4-layer) [规范 §5.2 铺铜策略 — pcb-design-rules.md]

power net GND (6 pads) has no copper pour/plane — power should be poured, not carried by thin tracks: `pcb pour-fit --net GND` (2-layer) or `pcb power-planes` (4-layer) [规范 §5.2 铺铜策略 — pcb-design-rules.md]

power net HEATER_VCC (2 pads) has no copper pour/plane — power should be poured, not carried by thin tracks: `pcb pour-fit --net HEATER_VCC` (2-layer) or `pcb power-planes` (4-layer) [规范 §5.2 铺铜策略 — pcb-design-rules.md]

power net +3V3: 10 track(s) below the power-branch spec width 9.84 mil (thinnest 6 mil) — widen for current capacity (route-short sizes by role; pour it instead, or --width-power to override) [规范 §1.2 推荐线宽 — pcb-design-rules.md]

power net GND: 11 track(s) below the gnd spec width 19.7 mil (thinnest 6 mil) — widen for current capacity (route-short sizes by role; pour it instead, or --width-power to override) [规范 §1.2 推荐线宽 — pcb-design-rules.md]

power net HEATER_VCC: 3 track(s) below the power-branch spec width 9.84 mil (thinnest 8 mil) — widen for current capacity (route-short sizes by role; pour it instead, or --width-power to override) [规范 §1.2 推荐线宽 — pcb-design-rules.md]
